# AJITDEV — Full Developer Platform & Technical Reference (Full Context)

> AJITDEV (https://next.ajitdev.com) is the central developer platform engineered by Ajit Dev. It spans modern full-stack web applications, DevOps automation, cloud architecture, system design, REST APIs, and local-first productivity tools.

## Entity & Developer Details
- Developer: Ajit Dev (known as AJITDEV / @ajitdev01)
- Location: Katihar, Bihar, India
- Role: Full Stack Developer, API Architect, DevOps & Cloud Security Engineer
- Organization / Affiliation: Brainzima Innovation (https://brainzima.com/)
- Official Portfolio: https://www.ajitdev.com/
- Public API Hub: https://api.ajitdev.com/

## Core Public Routes & Applications

### 1. Home (`/`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/
- Description: Central platform overview featuring an interactive architectural ecosystem visualizer, technical competencies across 6 core disciplines, real-time live metrics, and direct links to all sub-applications.

### 2. About (`/about`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/about
- Description: Complete profile of Ajit Dev, professional trajectory from 2024 to 2026+, verified external profiles, technical competencies (Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Docker, CI/CD, DevSecOps, System Design, DSA), and schema.org ProfilePage validation.

### 3. Projects Showcase (`/projects`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/projects
- Description: Curated catalog of production web applications, open-source repositories, developer tools, and client platforms built by Ajit Dev with live demos and repository links.

### 4. API Hub (`/api`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/api
- Description: Documentation and interactive test sandboxes for public REST and JSON developer endpoints, including currency conversion, meteorological telemetry, system utilities, and health checks.

### 5. Contact (`/contact`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/contact
- Description: Interactive contact form with automated server-side email dispatch, rate-limiting, and validation to connect directly with Ajit Dev for collaborations and technical consultations.

### 6. Currency Converter (`/currency`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/currency
- Description: Real-time foreign exchange converter supporting 31 global currencies with rates sourced from the European Central Bank (ECB), sub-second server-side caching, historical timeseries SVG charts, and parity matrix.

### 7. E-Commerce Store (`/store`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/store
- Description: Next.js 16 and Redux Toolkit production e-commerce storefront featuring client-side cart drawer, product catalogs, mock payment workflows, and confetti celebration checkout.

### 8. Weather App (`/weather`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/weather
- Description: Live meteorological telemetry client powered by OpenWeatherMap geocoding, displaying temperature, humidity, atmospheric pressure, wind metrics, and sunrise/sunset timings worldwide.

### 9. Todo App (`/todo`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/todo
- Description: Private, local-first task manager with priority filtering, category organization, and 100% in-browser persistence with zero tracking.

### 10. Notes App (`/note`)
- URL: https://next.ajitdev.com/note
- Description: Minimalist, local-first markdown note-taking tool featuring instant full-text client search, category tagging, and JSON export/import.

### 11. Privacy Policy (`/privacy`) & Terms of Service (`/terms`)
- Privacy: https://next.ajitdev.com/privacy
- Terms: https://next.ajitdev.com/terms
- Description: Transparent data protection disclosures, local storage usage guidelines, OAuth credential safeguards, and fair usage terms.
